response.sql:
WITH event_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    AVG(amount) as event_avg
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(event_avg) as overall_average
  FROM event_averages
),
filtered_events AS (
  SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.event_avg
  FROM event_averages ea, overall_avg oa
  WHERE ea.event_avg > oa.overall_average
),
filtered_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(event_avg) as filtered_average
  FROM filtered_events
)
SELECT 
  fe.link_to_event as event_link,
  fe.event_avg as average_amount,
  fe.event_avg - oa.overall_average as above_overall_average,
  fe.event_avg - fm.filtered_average as difference_from_kept_mean
FROM filtered_events fe, overall_avg oa, filtered_mean fm
ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "Ignoring missing amounts" means excluding NULL values from the average calculation (WHERE amount IS NOT NULL), the standard interpretation for averaging.
